# Tribes

The twelve normal tribes, Cymanti, Polaris, Elyrion and Aquarion are supported. A tribe without `starting_stars` starts with 5 stars. The `none` and `nature` rows are internal and not listed. The start tech list always includes `basic`. The version of the rules shown is 28.

*Bonus* is a map generation switch: `2` makes the capital's neighbouring fields fungi (Cymanti's spores start). The other values do nothing in the engine.

## Map weights

Terrain and resource weights multiply the chance of that terrain or resource around the tribe's capital during map generation (1 when absent). See [map generation](../map-generation.md).

| Tribe | Terrain weights | Resource weights |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aimo` | mountain=1.5 | crop=0.1 |
| `aquarion` | forest=0.5 | aquacrop=1.5, crop=0.5 |
| `bardur` | forest=0.8 | crop=0 |
| `elyrion` | mountain=0.5 | crop=1.5 |
| `hoodrick` | forest=1.5, mountain=0.5 | - |
| `imperius` | - | fruit=2, game=0.5 |
| `kickoo` | mountain=0.5, water=2 | fish=1.5 |
| `luxidoor` | - | - |
| `oumaji` | forest=0.2, mountain=0.5, water=0.5 | game=0.2 |
| `quetzali` | - | crop=0.1, fruit=2 |
| `vengir` | - | fish=0.1, fruit=0.1, game=0.1, metal=2 |
| `xinxi` | mountain=1.5 | metal=1.5 |
| `yadakk` | forest=0.5, mountain=0.5 | fruit=1.5 |
| `zebasi` | forest=0.5, mountain=0.5 | fruit=0.5 |
| `polaris` | - | - |
| `cymanti` | mountain=1.2 | crop=0, spores=0.3 |

## Replacements

A tribe uses its own tech, unit or improvement where the standard one is named (standard on the left).

| Tribe | Techs | Units | Improvements |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `aquarion` | `chivalry` -> `spearing`<br>`fishing` -> `aquafishing`<br>`ramming` -> `aquaculture`<br>`roads` -> `waterways`<br>`sailing` -> `marinelife` | `archer` -> `mermaidarcher`<br>`bombership` -> `jelly`<br>`catapult` -> `aquapult`<br>`cloak` -> `mermaidcloak`<br>`dagger` -> `mermaiddagger`<br>`defender` -> `mermaiddefender`<br>`giant` -> `crab`<br>`mindbender` -> `siren`<br>`rammership` -> `shark`<br>`rider` -> `amphibian`<br>`swordsman` -> `mermaidswordsman`<br>`warrior` -> `mermaidwarrior` | `burnforest` -> `fertilize` |
| `elyrion` | `hunting` -> `forestmagic`<br>`whaling` -> `watermagic` | `giant` -> `dragonegg` | `burnforest` -> `none`<br>`clearforest` -> `sanctuary` |
| `polaris` | `aquaculture` -> `sledding`<br>`aquatism` -> `polarism`<br>`fishing` -> `frostwork`<br>`navigation` -> `polarwarfare`<br>`sailing` -> `icefishing` | `archer` -> `icearcher`<br>`giant` -> `gaami` | `market` -> `icebank` |
| `cymanti` | `chivalry` -> `shock`<br>`construction` -> `recycling`<br>`meditation` -> `rituals`<br>`philosophy` -> `mysticism` | `archer` -> `phychi`<br>`bombership` -> `island`<br>`catapult` -> `exida`<br>`cloak` -> `moth`<br>`dagger` -> `bugegg`<br>`defender` -> `kiton`<br>`giant` -> `centipede`<br>`knight` -> `doomux`<br>`mindbender` -> `shaman`<br>`pirate` -> `bugegg`<br>`rammership` -> `boomchi`<br>`rider` -> `hexapod`<br>`scoutship` -> `raychi`<br>`swordsman` -> `mantis` | `bridge` -> `none`<br>`farm` -> `fungi`<br>`market` -> `clathrus`<br>`port` -> `algae`<br>`road` -> `mycelium` |
